user_saw: Typing a Usage filter returned no autocomplete suggestion when the only matching value was beyond the first six catalog entries.
summary: Usage autocomplete now searches the full catalog for each categorical filter and displays up to six matches.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already truncated candidate lists before matching, and the September inventory refactor preserved that order. The offline history lookup stopped at a missing parent, so I could not verify whether the cap shipped with autocomplete or was added later.
